elaine_docs: Heads-up: I'm opening PR to add a 'Dedicated capacity: quick migration & provisioning' microguide. Scope: short YAML example, Python + CLI snippets, clear line on autoscale cooldown vs tenant-affinity, migration mapping for reserved->dedicated keys, and fix a stale internal runbook link. asking for quick review.

jamal_eng: Please include a tiny troubleshooting note: why a tenant might fallback to shared_pool and how to detect it (metrics to check).

kevin: Also call out SDK compatibility: older clients (<0.9) use min_instances/max_instances. Add an explicit mapping table line.

deploy-bot: Link check: detected 1 broken link in draft -> /docs/provisioning. Replacement suggested: /runbooks/dedicated-provisioning-handbook.

elaine_docs: Thanks, adding fallback checklist (metrics: dedicated_pool_utilization, fallback_count), compatibility mapping line, and swapping link. Will assign reviews and merge after sanity SDK run.

jamal_eng: LGTM for tech content. Minor grammar nits in the YAML caption.

elaine_docs: Fixed microcopy, merging after CI passes. Thanks!
